preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 3 and 100,000.
The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The permutation p must contain n distinct numbers representing the vertices in clockwise or counterclockwise order.
The permutation q must contain n-2 distinct numbers representing the order of cutting pieces.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and all(1 <= x <= n - 2 for x in q)
postconditions.description: All elements in p must be within the range [1, n] and all elements in q must be within the range [1, n-2].
